evals.prompt: 把这个 PRD 按 vertical slice 拆成 GitHub issues，先给 draft，不要创建远端 issue。
evals.expected_output: Produces draft issue plan with AFK/HITL marking, acceptance criteria, verification, dependencies, and coverage matrix.

assertions.text: Does not create remote GitHub issues without confirmation.

evals.prompt: 这份 PRD 好像还有待确认项，但帮我拆成研发可以领取的 issues。
evals.expected_output: Runs PRD readiness gate and marks blockers or HITL clarification instead of pretending all issues are AFK.

assertions.text: Does not hide unresolved product questions inside AFK tickets.
Does not invent issue backlog from a vague idea.

evals.prompt: 帮我审一下这份 PRD 有没有缺口。
evals.expected_output: Routes artifact review to prd-review before issue splitting.

assertions.text: Does not skip readiness review when the user asks for review.
